modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: CLI bootstrap that loads settings, builds the repository, initializes the SQLite schema, and prints readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable runtime settings and loads MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY from the environment.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Holds the Order data model used across handlers, audit code, and storage.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds lightweight audit event dictionaries for API responses; it does not persist them.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Maps request payloads and repository calls to response dictionaries for order create and read operations.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers HTTP route callbacks on an injected app object.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed repository that creates the orders table, inserts orders, and fetches orders by id.

entry_points.notes: Bootstraps local storage and prints the selected database path.

entry_points.exposed_via: Called by an external HTTP app bootstrap not present in this repo
entry_points.notes: Binds POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> handlers to the provided app and repository.
Constructs an Order from request payload, saves it, and returns an event in the response body.
Loads an order by id and returns either a missing response or the order plus a read event.

key_functions.details: Loads Settings from os.environ, builds OrderRepository with settings.database_path, initializes the orders table, prints the selected DB path, and returns 0.
important_notes: Reads readonly config but does not enforce it.

key_functions.summary: Creates runtime Settings from environment variables.
key_functions.details: Uses MINISVC_DB with default orders.sqlite and sets readonly when MINISVC_READONLY == "1".
important_notes: Only this module reads the env vars.

key_functions.details: Pulls order_id, customer, and total_cents from payload, coerces total_cents to int, saves the Order, and returns a created response with an embedded audit event.
important_notes: No validation layer, retry loop, or readonly guard is present.

key_functions.details: Fetches an order by id and returns either a missing response or the order payload plus a read event.
Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> callbacks on an injected app instance.
important_notes: The actual web framework and app bootstrap live outside this fixture.

key_functions.details: Creates the orders table if it does not exist.
Opens a fresh sqlite3 connection and issues a plain INSERT into orders.
important_notes: No retry, readonly, or duplicate-key handling is present.

key_functions.details: Selects one row from orders and returns Order(*row) when found.
Returns a dictionary with type, action, order_id, and total_cents fields.
important_notes: Pure formatter only; no storage side effects.

runtime_flows.name: cli_startup
runtime_flows.trigger: minisvc.cli:main via the minisvc console script

steps.action: Read process environment and call minisvc.config:load_settings.
Resolve database_path from MINISVC_DB or default to orders.sqlite; parse readonly from MINISVC_READONLY.
Open sqlite3 connection and create the orders table if missing.
Print readiness message and exit with code 0.

runtime_flows.name: http_create_order
runtime_flows.trigger: POST /orders after an external app calls minisvc.api.routes:register_routes

steps.action: Bind POST /orders to a lambda that forwards payload and repo to minisvc.api.handlers:create_order.
Read order_id, customer, and total_cents from the request payload and build an Order dataclass.
Open sqlite3 connection and insert the order row into the orders table.
Build a created-event dictionary from the saved order.
Return a response dict with status=created, order_id, and the event payload.

runtime_flows.name: http_get_order
runtime_flows.trigger: GET /orders/<order_id> after an external app calls minisvc.api.routes:register_routes

steps.action: Bind GET /orders/<order_id> to a lambda that forwards the path parameter and repo to minisvc.api.handlers:get_order.
Call repo.get(order_id) to load an Order or None.
Select the row from sqlite and materialize Order(*row) when present.
Return a missing response when no row exists, else return order.__dict__ plus a read event.
